title: Atomic Habits
author: James Clear
synopsis: A practical framework for building good habits and breaking bad ones through tiny changes that compound over time, built on four laws: make it obvious, attractive, easy and satisfying.

title: The Varieties of Scientific Experience
author: Carl Sagan
synopsis: Sagan's 1985 Gifford Lectures, published posthumously: a personal view on science, the cosmos and the search for God, arguing for wonder grounded in evidence.

title: Crush It!
author: Gary Vaynerchuk
synopsis: Gary Vee's call to turn your passion into a business by building a personal brand on social media, and the hustle it takes to make it work.

title: How to Take Smart Notes
author: Sönke Ahrens
synopsis: An introduction to the Zettelkasten method: how a slip-box of connected, permanent notes turns reading into writing and thinking into a routine.

title: Building a Second Brain
author: Tiago Forte
synopsis: A methodology for capturing, organizing and sharing what you learn in a digital system (CODE and PARA), so your ideas become finished work.

title: Purple Cow
author: Seth Godin
synopsis: Why being remarkable is the only safe marketing strategy: stop blending in with the herd and build products worth talking about.

title: Essentialism
author: Greg McKeown
synopsis: The disciplined pursuit of less: how to separate the vital few from the trivial many and say no to everything that isn't essential.

title: The Psychology of Money
author: Morgan Housel
synopsis: Nineteen short stories on how behavior, not intelligence, drives financial outcomes, and what timeless lessons say about wealth, greed and happiness.

title: Slow Productivity
author: Cal Newport
synopsis: The lost art of accomplishment without burnout, built on three principles: do fewer things, work at a natural pace, and obsess over quality.

title: Feel-Good Productivity
author: Ali Abdaal
synopsis: How to do more of what matters by boosting energy rather than forcing discipline, using a framework of play, power and people.

title: Getting Things Done
author: David Allen
synopsis: The classic system for stress-free productivity: capture everything, clarify what it means, organize it and review it regularly.

title: Deep Work
author: Cal Newport
synopsis: Rules for focused success in a distracted world: why the ability to concentrate without distraction is rare, valuable and trainable.

title: The Sense of Style
author: Steven Pinker
synopsis: A cognitive scientist's guide to clear, elegant writing in the 21st century, drawing on linguistics and psychology instead of rigid rules.

title: Storynomics
author: Robert McKee & Thomas Gerace
synopsis: Story-driven marketing in the post-advertising world: how to use the principles of great storytelling to build brands people care about.
